headline.caveat: Talen-disclosed expected contracted revenue through 2042 — the only US nuclear-AI PPA with a public price. Up to 1,920MW from Susquehanna (PA).

realized_to_date.caveat: Deliveries under way (initial capacity since the 2024 co-located arrangement; ramp to full 1,920MW by early 2030s), but cumulative payments are not broken out.

annualized_flow.caveat: Straight-line ~$18B/17yr at full ramp; actual near-term run-rate is lower during ramp-up.

nature_md: Expanded PPA under which AWS buys up to 1,920MW from Talen's Susquehanna nuclear plant through 2042. It restructured the original 2024 behind-the-meter arrangement (AWS bought Talen's adjacent Cumulus data-center campus for ~$650M) into a grid-connected, front-of-the-meter supply after FERC rejected the enlarged co-located interconnection in Nov 2024. Take-or-pay-style committed offtake; capacity ramps in tranches to full size around the early 2030s.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Amazon expenses delivered power as data-center opex (cost of sales for AWS); the multi-year commitment sits in purchase-obligation disclosures, not on the balance sheet. The 2024 campus purchase (~$650M) was separate capex.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Talen recognizes energy revenue as delivered and has guided to ~$18B of contracted revenues through 2042, transforming its hedge profile — effectively converting a merchant nuclear asset into a quasi-contracted utility cash flow (~8-10% FCF accretion guidance).

both_sides_md: **Bull:** the benchmark deal proving hyperscalers will pay long-tenor, premium prices for firm carbon-free power; Talen gets utility-like cash-flow certainty. **Bear:** a single customer now anchors Talen's equity story (concentration), and the FERC co-location fight showed regulatory risk in data-center power deals can rewrite structures mid-flight.

events.title: Talen and Amazon expand Susquehanna deal to $18B grid-connected PPA
events.why_it_matters: The only nuclear-AI PPA with a disclosed dollar value; template for the IPP-hyperscaler model.
